hooks.name: Keep PROJECT-STATE.md live after every change
hooks.description: After any agent turn that made a meaningful change, fix, or decision in the workspace, refresh PROJECT-STATE.md so it stays a true live picture of the project. Covers all changes, not only spec-task completions.

action.prompt:
The agent turn just ended. Decide whether this turn made a meaningful change, fix, or strategic decision to the project (code edits, config/migration/CI changes, a resolved bug, a design/architecture decision, a dependency or stack change, a spec task completed, or a live-cloud action). If it did NOT (pure Q&A, read-only investigation, or no durable change), do nothing and stop.

If it DID, update the living docs so they stay a true, live picture anyone (including Kiro cold) can read. PROJECT-STATE.md is now a THIN entry point; the durable prose lives in satellite docs under docs/state/. Rules:

- Machine-managed STATE block in PROJECT-STATE.md: edit ONLY the lines between '<!-- BEGIN STATE -->' and '<!-- END STATE -->'. Keep the exact three-line format: '- **Phase:**', '- **Updated:**' (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD), and '- **Summary:**'. Keep BOTH the Phase and Summary lines SHORT — a one-to-three-sentence "where we are right now". Do NOT paste per-turn narrative onto them.
- Per-turn narrative / session journal: append a dated entry to docs/state/CHANGELOG.md (newest-first). This is where the running history goes — never grow it onto the STATE Summary line.
- Durable detail lives in the satellite docs, not in PROJECT-STATE.md: code structure -> docs/state/CODE-MAP.md; a new architecture/design decision -> docs/state/DECISIONS.md; an open risk/obstacle or dependency triage -> docs/state/RISKS.md; next steps -> docs/state/NEXT-STEPS.md. Update the satellite the change actually affects (add a decision bullet, retire a closed risk, etc.).
- PROJECT-STATE.md prose that DOES still live there: §1 what-this-is, §2 stack, §4 spec-completion-status table, §5 build/CI. Update those in place only when the spec-status or build picture changed.
- Be concise and strictly factual. Do not invent progress not reflected in the code, specs, or this turn's actions. Distinguish locally-verified work from live-cloud claims.
- Never write any secret value, key, token, or JWT into any of these files — reference credentials by name only.
- Kill-gate PASS/CUT verdicts go in RESEARCH-LOG.md via the Living-Docs Writer's append path, NEVER in PROJECT-STATE.md or its satellites. Do not touch LESSONS.md (hand-authored constraints).
- Make the edits and stop; do not run builds, tests, or commits.
